messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20: The Dune team owns the image resizer.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer: Ownership change: the image resizer now sits with team Ember. Team Dune no longer owns it.
- [2025-11-26] handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer: The Atlas team is taking over the image resizer from the Ember team, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-08-19] standup/dune/2025-08-19-2: Observation from the Dune team: after the runtime upgrade, the resizer's cold start time tripled.
- [2025-10-15] standup/atlas/2025-10-15: Team Atlas noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-09-05] standup/dune/2025-09-05: The Dune team still owns the scheduler, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-03-20] standup/dune/2025-03-20: Reminder: the reports pipeline is owned by Dune.
- [2026-03-17] standup/atlas/2026-03-17: Decided in today's standup: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, since storage for originals doubled in six months. For anything Atlas-related, page Priya.
- [2025-04-14] standup/cinder/2025-04-14: The catalog service calls the resizer for thumbnails, so treat the resizer as a hard dependency of the catalog service.
- [2026-03-09] handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2026-02-11: the flags service went to team Atlas, not Dune. Dune never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2025-06-27] handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction: Correction to the handover note of 2025-06-11: the notification service went to the Dune team, not team Cinder. The Cinder team never owned it; the note was written against the wrong team.
- [2026-02-16] standup/dune/2026-02-16: The Dune team noticed that the product catalog's request volume halved after the client rollout and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-21] standup/dune/2025-04-21: The Dune team adopted a monthly game day.
- [2025-07-24] standup/dune/2025-07-24: The Dune team sits on the fourth floor.
- [2026-06-09] standup/dune/2026-06-09: Observation from team Dune: after the retention change, search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent.
- [2025-12-29] standup/dune/2025-12-29: Observation from team Dune: after the client rollout, the event-bus' request volume halved.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20-2: The reporting service is a the Dune team service.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-4: The Dune team planning meeting is every Wednesday.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-2: The Dune team noticed that auth-gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.
- [2025-09-23] standup/dune/2025-09-23-2: Team Dune noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the product catalog.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-2: The Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-13] standup/dune/2025-01-13: First on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.
- [2026-05-22] standup/dune/2026-05-22-3: Heads-up from the Dune team: the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14: Rotation day for the Dune team: Tomasz hands the pager to Farah.
- [2025-01-09] standup/dune/2025-01-09: Farah runs team Dune solo until the next hire lands.
- [2025-04-17] standup/cinder/2025-04-17: Decision: the catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table, because the joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.
- [2025-09-23] handover/2025-09-23-scheduler: From today the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: For the record, the webhook dispatcher is owned by team Boreal.
- [2026-01-16] standup/dune/2026-01-16: On-call rotation: Farah Haddad is primary for team Dune starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The Boreal team owns the notifier.
- [2025-11-17] standup/dune/2025-11-17: Farah still has the Dune pager.
- [2025-12-05] handover/2025-12-05-reporting: From today the pager for reporting rings the Ember team, not the Dune team. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-03-26] standup/dune/2025-03-26: Reminder that the reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. Observation from team Dune: after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: For the record, the indexer is owned by Cinder.
